basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast exploring Reddit for the latest insights and solutions to tech issues. Based in Austin, Texas, they work as a junior IT specialist. Enjoys diving into cryptocurrency discussions and exploring the nature of consciousness. Typically online during the evenings and weekends. Single and enjoys watching wrestling in their downtime.
